text:
nina: CI failing after bump to redwood-inference-js@1.6.0. Jest jobs on ubuntu-lts error with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM, local node 18 on mac is fine.
aj: paste the error?

nina: ```
Error [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: Must use import to load ES Module /workspace/node_modules/redwood-inference-js/dist/index.mjs
```

sam: that usually means the package publishes only ESM (exports/import) and no CJS require entry. Can you check package.json in node_modules?

nina: snippet: { "name": "redwood-inference-js", "version": "1.6.0", "type": "module", "exports": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" } }

aj: yep no "require" -> CJS tools will try require() and fail. Short-term hacks: 1) vitest: set deps.inline: ['redwood-inference-js'] 2) jest: transform the package via esbuild-jest and update transformIgnorePatterns to allow that package 3) add a manual CJS mock and moduleNameMapper to point to it.

sam: long-term ask to SDK: publish dual bundles and add conditional exports: { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" } plus a `main` for older tooling. Also add example jest/vitest configs in README.

ci-bot: Pipeline 11214  failing tests on ubuntu-lts due to ERR_REQUIRE_ESM.

dev-bot: created ticket DEVEX-1100 to track test-runner guidance and SDK request.

nina: for now we'll apply esbuild-jest transform + a small manual mock in __mocks__ so CI is stable while SDK fixes upstream. I'll link the repro in the ticket.
aj: I'll add a short internal wiki page with example snippets for jest/vitest.

sam: thanks — please ping when upstream publishes a cjs entry so we can revert the hack.

nina: will do. :+1:
